task_title: One authoritative PR-lifecycle state machine (Issue #1851, D1/D5/D9/D11)

plan_review.notes: Adversarial plan review. Three alternatives enumerated: A=full rewrite, B=dual-registry, C=thin overlay. C chosen. A and B argued against: A risks breaking 618 tests; B creates synchronization bugs worse than current three-writer topology. Found 3 blocking+1 non-blocking: (1) evaluatePhase never called in production; (2) eligible() still had fingerprint gate; (3) reconcile.mjs never imported pr-lifecycle.mjs; (4) coordinator used applyLifecycleDecision with raw labels. All 4 resolved. Plan divergence: major_fork.

rounds.notes: 8 findings resolved: (1) applyLifecycleDecision never called - fixed; (2) D11 bypassed lifecyclePhase=null - fixed with lifecycle comment parsing; (3) ORDERING label conflict - fixed; (4) evaluateAdmission schema mismatch - fixed; (5) force-push no-op stale - fixed; (6) coordinator selectCoordination deferred to Issue 8; (7) empty train/cluster state - improved with comment parsing; (8) LIFECYCLE_MARKER missing from imports - fixed.

All 8 findings valid. GPT-sol and gemini-pro largely concordant (3 HIGH findings identical). All resolved in Round 1. Coordinator whoMustLandFirst() wiring deferred to Issue 8 - adjudicator assessed acceptable since no PR reaches quarantined without Issue 8 transitions.
